name: Assassin's Creed Odyssey
notes: VERIFIED 10 Sep 2026 on M4 16GB, macOS 26.5.1: played to a loaded map on the game-host tree (winecx 11.15) and exited clean. Layer confirmed by lsof on the live process, not by profile intent — libd3dshared=3, winemetal=0, so D3DMetal drove the RHI while the DXMT payload sat resident-and-unselected in system32. That makes Odyssey the first non-Unreal confirmation of the §5 coexistence work. Log: ~/wyn-handovers/play-ac-odyssey-20260910-004217.log. CAVEAT ON THIS CLAIM: no launch record exists, because the session was started from the `wyn play` CLI and only WynApp (the GUI) ever calls LaunchRecordStore.append — the CLI has no writer at all. Play it from the app for >60s (LaunchObserver.minimumUptime) and a record appears; nothing needs fixing first. No frame count either, and that one is structural: SessionPerformance requires profile.unrealProject and Odyssey is AnvilNext, so Wyn's measurement path cannot see it. Use the game's own built-in benchmark. The evidence here is a person and a log, not a measurement. AnvilNext DX11 on Apple Silicon. Old winecx path used CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal and ACOdyssey AppDefaults d3d*=b; current stack is the same D3DMetal builtins via translationLayer d3dmetal + WINEDLLOVERRIDES d3d11,dxgi,d3d12,d3d10,atidxx64,nvapi64,nvngx=b. In-game 1080p low–med ~70% scale. Ubisoft Connect required, and its credentials live per WINDOWS user: winecx 11.15 resolves to `crossover`, wine 11.0 to the macOS user, so a sign-in on one tree is invisible to the other. An unsigned-in game-host Connect does not show a sign-in prompt — its UI is transparent — it silently lands on Ubisoft's bot-check page. ConnectLauncher.shareConnectProfileAcrossWineUsers now links the two so this cannot recur. Connect CEF: win10; winhttp=b,n; dwrite=builtin (NOT empty — empty breaks libcef import); d2d1/d3d10core=d; Mac Driver RetinaMode=N Decorated=Y AllowOpenGL=Y. DO NOT re-add libEGL/libglesv2=d: a 9 Aug AppDefaults set caused the gl_factory_win.cc(63) NOTREACHED storm. Removed 12 Aug. MetalFX/HUD stay off.
